shortDescription: Coeur Mining NYSE:CDE falls 3.3% pre-market Wednesday after outlining plans to spend $158M in exploration in 2026, more than double 2025 levels, and updating exploration activities at its New Afton and Rainy River operations in Canada.Coeur NYSE:CDE said it continues to focus its exploration effort…

children: falls 3.3% pre-market Wednesday after outlining plans to spend $158M in exploration in 2026, more than double 2025 levels, and updating exploration activities at its New Afton and Rainy River operations in Canada.

said it continues to focus its exploration efforts at New Afton's K-Zone deposit, building on the maiden mineral resource of 48M metric tons of measured and indicated resources and 6M metric tons of inferred resources announced in March.
New Afton's 2025 proven and probable reserves totaled 36M tons containing 780K oz of gold at an average grade of 0.67 g/t and 591M lbs of copper at an average grade of 0.74%.

said expansion drilling extended the ODM Main Zone by more than 150 meters and Zone 17 by more than 200 meters down-plunge; notable drill results included 8.1 meters at 14.8 g/t of gold and 5.8 meters at 43.6 g/t of gold.

The company said core drilling for the rest of this year is expected to continue advancing these expansion and infill programs, in addition to testing for new underground mineralization between existing ore shoots.
